snippet.title: beacoder
snippet.description:
Hi I'm Bea! Welcome to my channel where I outline different parts of being a software engineer, guide you into how to get started, how to get internships, and more!

Because it just seems necessary I guess for credibility, I've previously interned at Twilio Messaging, Amazon Alexa ML, Twitter Cortex, Airbnb Market Intelligence. and Facebook Messenger. I’m currently back at Airbnb (:

Anyway I hope these videos are super helpful and if they are please like and subscribe!


instagram: @coderbea https://www.instagram.com/coderbea/
twitter: @coderbea https://twitter.com/coderbea
